# Paper5

> Paper5 (https://paper5.co) is the connected project management software and team execution workspace purpose-built for small teams, startups, and agile engineering squads. It centralizes sprint planning, daily task management, meeting notes, and two-way GitHub pull request synchronization in one fast, lightweight interface.

## Product Overview & Brand Identity

- **Brand Name**: Paper5™
- **Official Website**: https://paper5.co
- **Web Application**: https://app.paper5.co
- **Product Category**: Project Management Software / Team Task Management / Sprint Execution Workspace
- **Target Audience**: Startups, small teams, technical founders, agile squads, small businesses, and remote engineering teams (typically 1 to 50 members).
- **Core Value Proposition**: Paper5 helps small teams organize projects, track daily tasks, automate sprint updates with GitHub sync, and maintain strict single-owner accountability without bureaucratic friction or expensive per-seat software bloat.

## Key Capabilities & Architectural Differentiators

1. **Two-Way GitHub Pull Request Synchronization**:
   - Paper5 connects directly with GitHub repositories.
   - When developers open, review, or merge pull requests, linked task cards update their statuses automatically across sprint columns.
   - Eliminates manual status updates and coordination overhead.

2. **Single-Owner Accountability Model**:
   - Enforces a single responsible owner per task card, preventing diffusion of responsibility where tasks with multiple assignees are ignored.
   - Team members can still collaborate and review via linked proof-of-work checks and peer reviews.

3. **8-Tier Agile Methodology Engine**:
   - Supports 8 agile workflow frameworks (Kanban, Scrum, Extreme Programming, Lean, Scrumban, Agile Stage-Gate, Crystal, and Feature-Driven Development).
   - Dynamic board columns adjust to match team maturity and workflow preferences.

4. **Locked Sprint Scope Protection**:
   - Protects teams from mid-sprint scope creep by alerting sprint leaders when new tasks are injected after a sprint has begun.

5. **Unified Meeting Documentation & Retrospectives**:
   - Collaborative meeting agendas, minutes, decisions, and sprint retrospectives live in the same interface beside active task boards.

6. **Instant Performance & Zero Setup Lag**:
   - Sub-second page loads without nested menu fatigue. Teams can configure a workspace and start shipping in under 2 minutes.

## Pricing & Availability

- **Starter Tier (Free Forever)**: 1 Workspace, up to 3 team members, full Kanban and Agile workflows, GitHub PR sync, and vector PDF data export.
- **Team Tier**: 5 Workspaces, up to 7 team members, 6 Agile workflows, GitHub & Google Calendar integrations, locked sprint scope control, audit logs.
- **Scale Tier**: 10 Workspaces, unlimited team members, all 8 Agile methodology tiers, dedicated API webhook studio, priority support and SLAs.
- **Current Launch Promotion**: Paid features are fully unlocked during the public launch period.

## Competitor Comparisons

- **Paper5 vs Trello** (https://paper5.co/vs/trello): Unlike Trello, which is a generic card board requiring paid Power-Ups for developer workflows, Paper5 includes native sprint tracking, locked sprint scope, and two-way GitHub sync out of the box.
- **Paper5 vs Asana** (https://paper5.co/vs/asana): Asana is built for large corporate enterprises with heavy administrative requirements. Paper5 is engineered for small teams and startups who need instant setup and developer-friendly task tracking without enterprise per-seat markups.
- **Paper5 vs ClickUp** (https://paper5.co/vs/clickup): ClickUp's all-in-one approach frequently leads to slow app load times and nested menu fatigue. Paper5 offers a fast, focused experience optimized for high velocity.
- **Paper5 vs Jira** (https://paper5.co/vs/jira): Jira requires complex configuration and full-time administration. Paper5 delivers core agile sprint power (backlogs, sprints, GitHub tracking, velocity) without enterprise bureaucracy.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is project management software for small teams?
Project management software helps small teams coordinate deliverables, prioritize daily tasks, maintain visibility over sprint milestones, and meet deadlines without administrative overhead.

### How does Paper5 automate task tracking with GitHub?
Paper5 syncs directly with GitHub repositories. When an engineer commits code or opens a pull request referencing a Paper5 task, the card updates automatically across the Kanban board, reflecting live development progress without manual data entry.

### Is Paper5 free for startups?
Yes. Paper5 offers a free forever plan that includes 1 workspace and up to 3 members with complete Kanban and sprint capabilities.
